# CenterFace model

`centerface-dynamic.onnx` comes from [SCKEMPER/centerface-dynamic](https://huggingface.co/SCKEMPER/centerface-dynamic), which declares an MIT license. The published model retains the original CenterFace weights and declares dynamic input dimensions for ONNX Runtime.
